{{Top|leg}}
A '''portable clip recharger''' was a device capable of recharging [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster power packs]]. Each recharger had six slots, into which power packs could be slotted. Each pack could be recharged in two minutes, and the recharger was capable of charging thirty packs before it needed to hooked up to a [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]]. Several different companies produced portable clip rechargers; [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]' [[Ramtek]], [[Capris Technologies]]' [[CapTech Stealthpak]], and [[Power Products, Ltd.]]'s [[Ultrapaq]].
